supports: Coni and Bob Keyes opened the petting farm in Kissimmee in 1988
Children feed cattle, alpacas, donkeys, pigs, goats, chickens and rabbits by hand
One ticket covers the animals, the tractor-drawn wagon ride and the playground
The farm opens at 10 AM Wednesday through Sunday and is closed Monday and Tuesday, with last admission at 1 PM on weekdays and 2 PM on weekends

editorial.hook: Kids hand-feed farm animals, then ride the tractor wagon
editorial.why_here: Coni and Bob Keyes opened this Kissimmee petting farm in 1988, and families now return across generations. Children feed cattle, alpacas, donkeys, pigs, goats, chickens and rabbits by hand, with a tractor-drawn wagon ride and playground included.
editorial.know_before: There is no cafe on site, only vending machines; bring a picnic to eat at the shaded tables.
editorial.local_tip: Arrive at opening, when the animals are at their most active and the paddocks are quiet.
